description: MainActivity.kt is the main activity for an Android note-taking application. It manages UI components such as note list, search, and actions for creating, editing, and deleting notes. It interacts with a NotesRepository for data persistence and handles user inputs and navigation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main entry point activity of the notes app, handles UI and user interactions.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Reloads notes from storage if specified and updates the list view accordingly.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters notes based on the search query, case-insensitive, updating the displayed list.

methods.name: openNoteDetail
methods.description: Navigates to the detail view for a specific note.

methods.name: showItemOptions
methods.description: Displays options to edit or delete the selected note.

methods.name: showAddEditDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog for adding a new note or editing an existing one.
